import math
import sys

def fft_algo(a, invert):
    n = len(a)
    j = 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        bitmask = n >> 1
        while j & bitmask:
            j &= ~bitmask
            bitmask >>= 1
        j |= bitmask
        if i < j:
            a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        angle = 2 * math.pi / length * (-1 if invert else 1)
        wlen_cos = math.cos(angle)
        wlen_sin = math.sin(angle)
        for i in range(0, n, length):
            w_cos = 1.0
            w_sin = 0.0
            for j in range(length // 2):
                u = a[i + j]
                v = a[i + j + length // 2] * w_cos + a[i + j + length // 2] * w_sin
                a[i + j] = u + v
                a[i + j + length // 2] = u - v
                temp_w = w_cos * wlen_cos - w_sin * wlen_sin
                w_sin = w_sin * wlen_cos + w_cos * wlen_sin
                w_cos = temp_w
        length <<= 1
    if invert:
        for i in range(n):
            a[i] /= n

def poly_multiply(a, b, mod):
    n = 1 << (max(a.__len__() + b.__len__() - 1).bit_length())
    A = [0.0] * n
    B = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(a)):
        x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        A[i] = (x & ((1 << 15) - 1)) + ((x >> 15) * 1e-6)
    for i in range(len(b)):
        x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        B[i] = (x & ((1 << 15) - 1)) + ((x >> 15) * 1e-6)
    fft_algo(A, False)
    fft_algo(B, False)
    FA = [0.0] * n
    FB = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        j = (n - i) & (n - 1)
        a_real = (A[i] + A[j]) * 0.5
        a_imag = (A[i] - A[j]) * 0.5
        b_real = (B[i] + B[j]) * 0.5
        b_imag = (B[i] - B[j]) * 0.5
        FA[i] = a_real * b_real - a_imag * b_imag
        FB[i] = a_real * b_imag + a_imag * b_real
    fft_algo(FA, True)
    fft_algo(FB, True)
    res = [0] * (len(a) + len(b) - 1)
    for i in range(len(res)):
        aa = round(FA[i])
        bb = round(FB[i])
        val = (aa + ((bb % mod) << 15)) % mod
        res[i] = int(val)
    return res

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    k = int(input_data[1])
    v = [0] * 10
    for i in range(k):
        v[int(input_data[2 + i])] = 1
    result_poly = [1]
    power = n // 2
    while power > 0:
        if (power & 1) == 1:
            result_poly = poly_multiply(result_poly, v, 998244353)
        v = poly_multiply(v, v, 998244353)
        power >>= 1
    total = 0
    for val in result_poly:
        total = (total + val * val) % 998244353
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
